ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Assetbundle
ContainedObjects.Nickname: Signal Relay A
ContainedObjects.Description: Cable Drum. Right-click after a successful Scenario Skill to record the controlling player.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
local base="Signal Relay A"
ownerSide='Neutral'
local tint={Neutral={1,1,1},A={.39,.78,1},B={1,.51,.32}}
function setNetworkSide(p)
 if p and tint[p.side] then ownerSide=p.side;self.setColorTint(tint[p.side]);self.setName(base..(ownerSide=='Neutral' and '' or (' | Player '..ownerSide)))end
end
function onLoad(s)
 self.setLock(true);setNetworkSide({side=tint[s] and s or 'Neutral'})
 for _,v in ipairs({'A','B','Neutral'}) do local side=v
  self.addContextMenuItem(side=='Neutral' and 'Set neutral' or ('Active for Player '..side),function(color)
   local ctl=getObjectFromGUID('cb7102');if ctl then ctl.call('claimNetworkObjective',{guid=self.getGUID(),side=side,color=color})end end)
 end
end
function onSave()return ownerSide end
